facts.fact: The Public Procurement Authority's chief executive says tenders are submitted online through GHANEPS, with manual tender submissions to be phased out.
The Public Procurement Authority board chairman says utilisation of GHANEPS is about 45%.

The Public Procurement Authority's chief executive says GHANEPS is integrated with the Ghana Integrated Financial Management Information System (GIFMIS), so procurement cannot begin unless funds are committed.

GHA.note: Cyber Security Authority named only as a collaborator; no incident, alert or creation stated.
